trigger.description: SRR6.46.46 auto-enrollment safety layer attempted to record the materialization audit-log entry but the write failed (disk full, permission denied, audit lane shut down, or sibling agent holds the audit-log lock past the timeout). SRR6.46.46.3 forces an abort with `auto_enrollment_audit_failed` rather than silently materializing the peer group without a durable audit record.
setup_commands: # force the audit-log path to be unwritable (chmod -w .ee/audit/ or fill disk)
